TKC.Title: Tokenatra Studio
TKC.Settings.ServerUrlHint: Base URL of Tokenatra on the GM's machine. The GM's client talks to it directly; players get the studio from this module and their AI requests are relayed automatically.
TKC.Settings.UploadTargetHint: Folder in the server Data directory where exported images are stored (GM only; players upload to their personal storage).
TKC.Settings.AutoApplyHint: When the studio was opened from an actor, exports update that actor's artwork immediately, without a dialog.
TKC.HelpTextOffline: Start the Tokenatra desktop app (keeping it in the system tray is fine) and press Retry.
TKC.HelpStep1: Install Tokenatra 26.4 or newer (see the button below).
TKC.HelpStep2: In Tokenatra: Settings → Model, pick a background-removal model (.onnx).
TKC.HelpStep3: Keep Tokenatra running (the tray is enough) and reopen this window.
TKC.InfoModelLoading: The model is being loaded after idle (first request takes ~10–30 s)…
TKC.ErrorNotRunning: Tokenatra is not running (see the studio window for help).
TKC.WarnOldApp: Your Tokenatra version is too old for the connector — update to 26.4+.
TKC.ErrorNoModel: Tokenatra has no background-removal model — pick one in Tokenatra: Settings → Model.
TKC.ErrorExportFetch: Could not download the exported file from Tokenatra.
TKC.ErrorNotRaster: Only raster images are supported (video/SVG artwork is not).
TKC.ErrorArtworkFetch: Could not read the actor artwork.
TKC.ErrorExternalArt: The artwork is hosted externally without CORS — save it locally first.
TKC.WarnNoUploadRights: You may not upload files — the result was downloaded to your computer instead.
TKC.WarnNoActorPermission: You don't have permission to edit {name}.
TKC.Settings.ShowSheetButtonHint: Adds a Tokenatra button to actor sheet headers (v13 header button / v14 header control).
TKC.HelpTextAuth: Tokenatra is reachable, but the access key is missing or wrong. Ask the GM to share the key from Tokenatra: Settings → Player access.
TKC.HelpAuthStep1: The GM enables network access and copies the address + key (Tokenatra: Settings → Player access).
TKC.HelpAuthStep2: The GM enters them in Configure Settings → Tokenatra Connector (world settings).
TKC.ErrorRelay: GM client is offline — Tokenatra relay unavailable.
TKC.ConnHost: No local Tokenatra found — using the host's Tokenatra (via the GM client)
TKC.ConnNone: Tokenatra is unavailable. Start it on your device, or ask the GM to start it and join the world
